description: This file defines the XCastManager class, which manages interactions with the gdial library for casting services, including initialization, application control, and power management.

classes.name: XCastManager
classes.description: Manager class for interacting with gdial library, handling application and service control, and maintaining singleton instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes gdialService to communicate with gdial server.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles application state changes, reporting to the gdial server.

methods.name: enableCastService
methods.description: Enables or disables cast service discovery.

methods.name: updateFriendlyName
methods.description: Updates the friendly name for the cast service.

methods.name: registerApplications
methods.description: Registers a list of applications with the cast manager.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of XCastManager.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequestWithLaunchParam
methods.description: Handles application launch requests with additional parameters.

methods.name: onStopped
methods.description: Callback for when the service stops.
